meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从CZ CELLxGene数据库获取版本化的单细胞和转录组数据
copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need versioned single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data from CZ CELLxGene

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能按物种、组织、疾病等条件,从 CZ CELLxgene Census 查询版本化的公开单细胞和空间转录组数据,包括细胞元数据、基因表达、汇总计数、H5AD 下载地址、预计算嵌入和空间数据,并可结合 scanpy 等工具分析。
howto.when: 当需要按物种、组织、疾病等条件,查询 Census 中群体级的细胞元数据、基因表达切片或摘要计数时触发;不用于分析本地单细胞数据。

say.text: 用小鼠肝脏数据训练 PyTorch 模型,按细胞类型分训练集和测试集。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can query versioned public single-cell/spatial data from CZ CELLxgene Census: filter metadata or expression by organism/tissue/disease; get summary counts, H5AD URIs, embeddings, spatial data; integrate with scanpy/PyTorch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when querying public CZ CELLxgene Census single-cell/spatial data, e.g., filter cell metadata, gene expression, or summary counts by organism, tissue, disease, etc. Not for local single-cell data.

say_en.text: Count cell types in human brain tissue, considering only is_primary_data cells.
say_en.note: Claude reads Census summary and get_obs to count.

say_en.text: Extract T and B cell expression from COVID-19 lung, genes CD4, CD8A, CD19.
Train a PyTorch model on mouse liver data with train/test split by cell type.
say_en.note: Claude uses TileDB-SOMA-ML to build loaders.
